title: Planning a team trip
scene: Two colleagues talk in the office

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 经理让我们安排下个月的公司旅游，你有什么想法？
lines.py: Jīnglǐ ràng wǒmen ānpái xià ge yuè de gōngsī lǚyóu, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ?
lines.en: The manager asked us to plan next month's company trip. Do you have any ideas?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我觉得去海边不错，大家平时工作太忙了，可以去放松一下。
lines.py: Wǒ juéde qù hǎibiān búcuò, dàjiā píngshí gōngzuò tài máng le, kěyǐ qù fàngsōng yíxià.
lines.en: I think the seaside would be nice. Everyone is too busy at work, so we could go and relax.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 海边是好，但是下个月已经是十月了，天气有点儿冷，不能游泳。
lines.py: Hǎibiān shì hǎo, dànshì xià ge yuè yǐjīng shì shí yuè le, tiānqì yǒudiǎnr lěng, bù néng yóuyǒng.
lines.en: The seaside is nice, but next month is already October. It will be a bit cold and we can't swim.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 那去山里怎么样？听说那里的景色特别美，秋天的时候叶子都是红色的。
lines.py: Nà qù shān li zěnmeyàng? Tīngshuō nàli de jǐngsè tèbié měi, qiūtiān de shíhou yèzi dōu shì hóngsè de.
lines.en: Then how about the mountains? I hear the scenery there is really beautiful, and in autumn the leaves are all red.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 这个主意好。不过有些同事身体不太好，爬山会不会太累？
lines.py: Zhège zhǔyi hǎo. Búguò yǒuxiē tóngshì shēntǐ bú tài hǎo, pá shān huì bu huì tài lèi?
lines.en: That's a good idea. But some colleagues aren't in great health. Will climbing the mountain be too tiring?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 不用担心，山上有路可以开车上去，不想走路的人可以坐车。
lines.py: Búyòng dānxīn, shān shang yǒu lù kěyǐ kāichē shàngqu, bù xiǎng zǒulù de rén kěyǐ zuò chē.
lines.en: Don't worry. There is a road up the mountain, so people who don't want to walk can go by car.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 那住的地方呢？我们一共有三十位同事。
lines.py: Nà zhù de dìfang ne? Wǒmen yígòng yǒu sānshí wèi tóngshì.
lines.en: What about a place to stay? There are thirty of us in total.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我上网查了一下，山下有一家酒店，房间很大，价格也不贵，每人每晚200块。
lines.py: Wǒ shàngwǎng chá le yíxià, shān xià yǒu yì jiā jiǔdiàn, fángjiān hěn dà, jiàgé yě bú guì, měi rén měi wǎn 200 kuài.
lines.en: I looked online. There's a hotel at the foot of the mountain with big rooms, and it isn't expensive: 200 yuan per person per night.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我们周五出发还是周六出发？
lines.py: Wǒmen zhōuwǔ chūfā háishi zhōuliù chūfā?
lines.en: Should we leave on Friday or on Saturday?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 周五下午出发吧，这样可以玩两天，周日晚上回来，不影响周一上班。
lines.py: Zhōuwǔ xiàwǔ chūfā ba, zhèyàng kěyǐ wán liǎng tiān, zhōurì wǎnshang huílai, bù yǐngxiǎng zhōuyī shàngbān.
lines.en: Let's leave on Friday afternoon. That way we get two days of fun, come back on Sunday evening, and Monday's work isn't affected.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好，那我先去问问经理的意见，他同意了我们就开始报名。
lines.py: Hǎo, nà wǒ xiān qù wènwen jīnglǐ de yìjiàn, tā tóngyì le wǒmen jiù kāishǐ bàomíng.
lines.en: OK, I'll ask the manager what he thinks first. Once he agrees, we'll start taking sign-ups.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 别忘了提醒大家带厚一点儿的衣服，山上晚上比较冷。
lines.py: Bié wàng le tíxǐng dàjiā dài hòu yìdiǎnr de yīfu, shān shang wǎnshang bǐjiào lěng.
lines.en: Don't forget to remind everyone to bring warmer clothes. It gets rather cold on the mountain at night.

questions.promptPy: Tāmen wèi shénme bú qù hǎibiān?
questions.promptEn: Why aren't they going to the seaside?
questions.explanation: In line 2 the woman says next month is October, so it will be cold and nobody can swim.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de dānxīn shénme?
questions.promptEn: What is the woman worried about?
questions.explanation: In line 4 she worries that climbing will be too tiring for colleagues who aren't in good health.

questions.promptPy: Jiǔdiàn měi rén měi wǎn duōshao qián?
questions.promptEn: How much is the hotel per person per night?
questions.explanation: Line 7 gives the price as 200 yuan per person per night.

questions.prompt: 他们打算什么时候回来？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen dǎsuàn shénme shíhou huílai?
questions.promptEn: When do they plan to come back?
questions.explanation: In line 9 the man suggests coming back on Sunday evening so Monday's work isn't affected.

questions.promptPy: Nán de tíxǐng dàjiā dài shénme?
questions.promptEn: What does the man want everyone reminded to bring?
questions.explanation: Line 11 says to bring warmer clothes because the mountain is cold at night.

title: Calling about a flat
scene: A young man phones a landlord about a flat for rent

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 您好，我在网上看到您的房子要出租，现在还有吗？
lines.py: Nín hǎo, wǒ zài wǎngshàng kàndào nín de fángzi yào chūzū, xiànzài hái yǒu ma?
lines.en: Hello, I saw online that your flat is for rent. Is it still available?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 还有。房子在三楼，有两个房间，一个厨房和一个卫生间。
lines.py: Hái yǒu. Fángzi zài sān lóu, yǒu liǎng ge fángjiān, yí ge chúfáng hé yí ge wèishēngjiān.
lines.en: It is. It's on the third floor, with two rooms, a kitchen and a bathroom.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 离地铁站远不远？我每天要坐地铁上班。
lines.py: Lí dìtiězhàn yuǎn bu yuǎn? Wǒ měi tiān yào zuò dìtiě shàngbān.
lines.en: Is it far from the subway station? I take the subway to work every day.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 不远，走路大概10分钟，附近还有一个大超市，买东西很方便。
lines.py: Bù yuǎn, zǒulù dàgài 10 fēnzhōng, fùjìn hái yǒu yí ge dà chāoshì, mǎi dōngxi hěn fāngbiàn.
lines.en: Not far, about ten minutes on foot. There's also a big supermarket nearby, so shopping is easy.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 房租一个月多少钱？
lines.py: Fángzū yí ge yuè duōshao qián?
lines.en: How much is the rent per month?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 一个月3500块，水电费另外交。
lines.py: Yí ge yuè 3500 kuài, shuǐdiànfèi lìngwài jiāo.
lines.en: 3,500 yuan a month. Water and electricity are paid separately.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 有点儿贵。我看别的房子差不多3000块。
lines.py: Yǒudiǎnr guì. Wǒ kàn bié de fángzi chàbuduō 3000 kuài.
lines.en: That's a bit expensive. Other flats I've seen are about 3,000.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我的房子去年刚修过，家具、冰箱和空调都是新的，你来看看就知道了。
lines.py: Wǒ de fángzi qùnián gāng xiū guo, jiājù, bīngxiāng hé kōngtiáo dōu shì xīn de, nǐ lái kànkan jiù zhīdào le.
lines.en: My flat was just done up last year, and the furniture, fridge and air conditioner are all new. Come and see it and you'll understand.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我晚上常常工作到很晚，那里安静吗？
lines.py: Wǒ wǎnshang chángcháng gōngzuò dào hěn wǎn, nàli ānjìng ma?
lines.en: I often work late at night. Is it quiet there?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 很安静，房间的窗户对着公园，不对着马路。
lines.py: Hěn ānjìng, fángjiān de chuānghu duìzhe gōngyuán, bú duìzhe mǎlù.
lines.en: Very quiet. The windows face a park, not the road.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 太好了。我明天下午三点过去看看，可以吗？
lines.py: Tài hǎo le. Wǒ míngtiān xiàwǔ sān diǎn guòqu kànkan, kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: Great. Can I come and have a look tomorrow at three in the afternoon?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 明天下午我要上班，六点以后可以吗？
lines.py: Míngtiān xiàwǔ wǒ yào shàngbān, liù diǎn yǐhòu kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: I'm at work tomorrow afternoon. Is after six OK?

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 可以，那就明天六点半见。
lines.py: Kěyǐ, nà jiù míngtiān liù diǎn bàn jiàn.
lines.en: Sure, see you tomorrow at half past six then.

questions.promptPy: Fángzi lí dìtiězhàn duō yuǎn?
questions.promptEn: How far is the flat from the subway station?
questions.explanation: In line 3 the landlord says it's about ten minutes on foot.

questions.promptPy: Fángzū yí ge yuè duōshao qián?
questions.promptEn: How much is the monthly rent?
questions.explanation: Line 5 gives the rent as 3,500 yuan a month; 3,000 is the price of other flats.

questions.prompt: 女的为什么觉得房租不贵？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de wèi shénme juéde fángzū bú guì?
questions.promptEn: Why does the woman think the rent is fair?
options: 去年刚修过，家具都是新的
questions.explanation: In line 7 she points out the flat was redone last year and the furniture is new.

questions.promptPy: Wèi shénme fángjiān hěn ānjìng?
questions.promptEn: Why is the flat quiet?
questions.explanation: Line 9 says the windows face a park rather than the road.

questions.prompt: 他们什么时候去看房子？
questions.promptPy: Tāmen shénme shíhou qù kàn fángzi?
questions.promptEn: When will they view the flat?
questions.explanation: Three o'clock doesn't work for the landlord, so in line 12 they agree on half past six tomorrow.

title: A job interview
scene: A manager interviews a new graduate

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 请坐。先简单介绍一下你自己吧。
lines.py: Qǐng zuò. Xiān jiǎndān jièshào yíxià nǐ zìjǐ ba.
lines.en: Please have a seat. First, tell me a little about yourself.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好的。我今年大学毕业，学的是电脑技术，在学校的时候参加过很多活动。
lines.py: Hǎo de. Wǒ jīnnián dàxué bìyè, xué de shì diànnǎo jìshù, zài xuéxiào de shíhou cānjiā guo hěn duō huódòng.
lines.en: Sure. I graduate from university this year. I studied computer science, and I took part in many activities at school.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你为什么想来我们公司工作？
lines.py: Nǐ wèi shénme xiǎng lái wǒmen gōngsī gōngzuò?
lines.en: Why do you want to work for our company?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我一直对你们公司的手机很感兴趣，而且听说公司很重视年轻人，给大家很多学习的机会。
lines.py: Wǒ yìzhí duì nǐmen gōngsī de shǒujī hěn gǎn xìngqù, érqiě tīngshuō gōngsī hěn zhòngshì niánqīngrén, gěi dàjiā hěn duō xuéxí de jīhuì.
lines.en: I've always been interested in your company's phones, and I hear the company values young people and gives them many chances to learn.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你有工作经验吗？
lines.py: Nǐ yǒu gōngzuò jīngyàn ma?
lines.en: Do you have any work experience?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 去年暑假我在一家做电脑的公司打工了两个月，主要负责检查电脑的问题。
lines.py: Qùnián shǔjià wǒ zài yì jiā zuò diànnǎo de gōngsī dǎgōng le liǎng ge yuè, zhǔyào fùzé jiǎnchá diànnǎo de wèntí.
lines.en: Last summer I worked for two months at a computer company, mainly checking computers for problems.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 这个工作常常需要加班，你能接受吗？
lines.py: Zhège gōngzuò chángcháng xūyào jiābān, nǐ néng jiēshòu ma?
lines.en: This job often needs overtime. Can you accept that?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 可以接受。只要工作有意思，加班我不怕。
lines.py: Kěyǐ jiēshòu. Zhǐyào gōngzuò yǒu yìsi, jiābān wǒ bú pà.
lines.en: Yes. As long as the work is interesting, I don't mind overtime.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 我们公司在城市的北边，比较远，你住在哪儿？
lines.py: Wǒmen gōngsī zài chéngshì de běibian, bǐjiào yuǎn, nǐ zhù zài nǎr?
lines.en: Our company is in the north of the city, rather far out. Where do you live?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我现在住在学校，如果能来工作，我打算在公司附近租房子。
lines.py: Wǒ xiànzài zhù zài xuéxiào, rúguǒ néng lái gōngzuò, wǒ dǎsuàn zài gōngsī fùjìn zū fángzi.
lines.en: I live at school now. If I get the job, I plan to rent a place near the company.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好。你对工资有什么要求？
lines.py: Hǎo. Nǐ duì gōngzī yǒu shénme yāoqiú?
lines.en: OK. What are your salary expectations?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 我刚毕业，经验还不多，我更想要的是能学到东西，工资按照公司的规定就可以。
lines.py: Wǒ gāng bìyè, jīngyàn hái bù duō, wǒ gèng xiǎng yào de shì néng xuédào dōngxi, gōngzī ànzhào gōngsī de guīdìng jiù kěyǐ.
lines.en: I've just graduated and don't have much experience. Learning matters more to me, so the company's standard pay is fine.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好的，今天就到这儿。我们会在下周三以前给你打电话。
lines.py: Hǎo de, jīntiān jiù dào zhèr. Wǒmen huì zài xià zhōusān yǐqián gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: All right, that's all for today. We'll call you before next Wednesday.

questions.promptPy: Nǚ de xué de shì shénme zhuānyè?
questions.promptEn: What did the woman study?
questions.explanation: In line 1 she says her major was computer science.

questions.prompt: 女的去年暑假做了什么？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de qùnián shǔjià zuò le shénme?
questions.promptEn: What did the woman do last summer?
options: 在一家做电脑的公司打工
questions.explanation: Line 5 says she worked for two months at a computer company.

questions.prompt: 关于加班，女的是什么态度？
questions.promptPy: Guānyú jiābān, nǚ de shì shénme tàidu?
questions.promptEn: What is the woman's attitude to overtime?
questions.explanation: In line 7 she says she can accept it as long as the work is interesting.

questions.prompt: 如果得到这个工作，女的打算怎么做？
questions.promptPy: Rúguǒ dédào zhège gōngzuò, nǚ de dǎsuàn zěnme zuò?
questions.promptEn: What does the woman plan to do if she gets the job?
questions.explanation: Line 9 says she plans to rent a place near the company.

questions.prompt: 公司什么时候给女的打电话？
questions.promptPy: Gōngsī shénme shíhou gěi nǚ de dǎ diànhuà?
questions.promptEn: When will the company call her?
questions.explanation: In line 12 the manager promises to call before next Wednesday.

title: A delayed flight
scene: Two passengers talk at the airport after a delay is announced

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你听到广播了吗？飞往上海的1501次航班，因为天气原因，推迟到晚上8点起飞。
lines.py: Nǐ tīngdào guǎngbō le ma? Fēi wǎng Shànghǎi de 1501 cì hángbān, yīnwèi tiānqì yuányīn, tuīchí dào wǎnshang 8 diǎn qǐfēi.
lines.en: Did you hear the announcement? Because of the weather, flight 1501 to Shanghai is delayed until 8 p.m.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 听到了。广播还说让大家在5号门附近休息，注意听通知。
lines.py: Tīngdào le. Guǎngbō hái shuō ràng dàjiā zài 5 hào mén fùjìn xiūxi, zhùyì tīng tōngzhī.
lines.en: I heard. It also said everyone should wait near gate 5 and listen for updates.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 真让人着急！本来是下午四点的飞机，现在要等四个小时。
lines.py: Zhēn ràng rén zháojí! Běnlái shì xiàwǔ sì diǎn de fēijī, xiànzài yào děng sì ge xiǎoshí.
lines.en: How annoying! It was supposed to leave at four, and now we have to wait four hours.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 是啊，听说上海那边雨下得很大。你也是去上海？
lines.py: Shì a, tīngshuō Shànghǎi nàbian yǔ xià de hěn dà. Nǐ yě shì qù Shànghǎi?
lines.en: Yes, I hear it's raining hard in Shanghai. Are you going to Shanghai too?

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 对，我去参加一个会议，明天早上九点开始。
lines.py: Duì, wǒ qù cānjiā yí ge huìyì, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn kāishǐ.
lines.en: Yes, I'm going to a meeting that starts at nine tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 那还来得及。我是去看我女儿，她在上海读大学。
lines.py: Nà hái láidejí. Wǒ shì qù kàn wǒ nǚ'ér, tā zài Shànghǎi dú dàxué.
lines.en: Then you'll still make it. I'm going to see my daughter. She's at university in Shanghai.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 你吃饭了吗？离起飞还早，我想去吃一点儿东西。
lines.py: Nǐ chīfàn le ma? Lí qǐfēi hái zǎo, wǒ xiǎng qù chī yìdiǎnr dōngxi.
lines.en: Have you eaten? There's plenty of time before take-off. I'd like to get something to eat.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 还没有。我刚才看见二楼有一家饭馆，看起来不错。
lines.py: Hái méiyǒu. Wǒ gāngcái kànjiàn èr lóu yǒu yì jiā fànguǎn, kàn qilai búcuò.
lines.en: Not yet. I just saw a restaurant on the second floor. It looks good.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 可是我的行李很重，拿着不方便。
lines.py: Kěshì wǒ de xíngli hěn zhòng, ná zhe bù fāngbiàn.
lines.en: But my luggage is heavy and awkward to carry around.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 你可以去前面的服务台问问，那里好像可以免费放行李。
lines.py: Nǐ kěyǐ qù qiánmiàn de fúwùtái wènwen, nàli hǎoxiàng kěyǐ miǎnfèi fàng xíngli.
lines.en: You could ask at the service desk up ahead. I think you can leave luggage there for free.

lines.speaker: 女
lines.zh: 好主意。我们一起去吧，吃完再回来等。
lines.py: Hǎo zhǔyi. Wǒmen yìqǐ qù ba, chīwán zài huílai děng.
lines.en: Good idea. Let's go together and come back to wait after we eat.

lines.speaker: 男
lines.zh: 好，别忘了带上你的机票。
lines.py: Hǎo, bié wàng le dàishang nǐ de jīpiào.
lines.en: OK. Don't forget to take your ticket.

questions.prompt: 女的为什么不想拿着行李去吃饭？
questions.promptPy: Nǚ de wèi shénme bù xiǎng ná zhe xíngli qù chīfàn?
questions.promptEn: Why doesn't the woman want to take her luggage to eat?
questions.explanation: Line 8 says her luggage is heavy and awkward to carry.
